# root-cause-analysis

Conducts systematic root cause analysis using proven methodologies including Toyota's 5 Whys, Ishikawa fishbone diagrams, Pareto analysis, and fault tree analysis. Use when investigating bugs, debugging code, troubleshooting systems, diagnosing equipment failures, analysing life problems, or identifying underlying causes of any issue across software engineering, hardware maintenance, process failures, or personal challenges.

- **Entry point:** [SKILL.md](SKILL.md)
- **Version:** 2.0
- **Licence:** Apache-2.0, see [LICENSE](LICENSE)

## Install

Copy this directory into either skills location, then start a new session:

```bash
cp -r root-cause-analysis ~/.claude/skills/       # personal, all projects
cp -r root-cause-analysis .claude/skills/         # this project only
```

For Claude Desktop, zip the directory and upload it under
Settings, Capabilities, Skills. Released builds attach a ready-made zip.

## Bundled files

Loaded on demand, not up front. SKILL.md routes to them.
